# API Design Principles, REST Style Guide & Free OpenAPI Validator (2026)

> Practical API design principles handbook (32 rules backed by RFC 9110, RFC 9457, RFC 8594, IETF Idempotency-Key, Google AIP, and OWASP API Top 10) paired with a zero-dependency OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 validator, GitHub Action, and interactive browser checker (Verified: 2026-11-16).

## Summary
`api-design-tools/api-design-principles` bridges the gap between static API style guides (such as Haufe-Lexware's api-style-guide) and automated CI/CD enforcement. It combines a practical reference dataset (`rules.json`), a zero-dependency Python CLI linter (`api_validator.py`), a drop-in composite GitHub Action (`action.yml`), and a live browser OpenAPI validator (`https://api-design-tools.github.io/api-design-principles/`).

## Core Automated OpenAPI Rules (ADP-001 to ADP-022)
- **Naming & Paths (`ADP-001`–`ADP-004`)**: Plural resource nouns without CRUD verbs (`/v1/orders`, never `/getUserOrders`), lowercase `kebab-case` segments, no trailing slashes, explicit major version prefix (`/v1`, `/v2`).
- **HTTP Method Semantics (`ADP-005`–`ADP-007`, `ADP-020`)**: `GET`/`HEAD` must never declare `requestBody`; `POST` creation returns `201 Created` (with `Location`) or `202 Accepted`; `DELETE` returns `204`/`202` without required body; `PATCH` (`application/merge-patch+json`) + `ETag`/`If-Match` for partial updates and concurrency.
- **Error Handling (`ADP-008`–`ADP-009`)**: Explicit `4xx` responses on every operation using `RFC 9457` Problem Details (`application/problem+json` with `type`, `title`, `status`, `detail`, `instance`).
- **Pagination (`ADP-010`–`ADP-011`)**: Bounded pagination on collection `GET` routes; prefer O(1) cursor/keyset pagination (`?cursor=...&limit=25`) over `OFFSET`.
- **Idempotency & Rate Limiting (`ADP-012`–`ADP-013`, `ADP-018`)**: `Idempotency-Key` header on `POST` mutations; `429 Too Many Requests` + `Retry-After` + `RateLimit-*` headers; `Deprecation` & `Sunset` headers (`RFC 8594`).
- **Security & AI/MCP Readiness (`ADP-014`–`ADP-017`, `ADP-019`, `ADP-021`–`ADP-022`)**: Enforce `https://` servers, declare `components.securitySchemes`, forbid secrets in URL query strings, require unique `operationId` + `summary`, realistic `example` payloads, `maxLength`/`maxItems` bounds (`OWASP API4:2023`), and ISO 8601 UTC `date-time` timestamps.

## Quick CLI & GitHub Action Usage
- Validate OpenAPI spec: `python3 api_validator.py --spec examples/orders-api-good.openapi.json --fail-on warning`
- Emit Markdown violation report: `python3 api_validator.py --spec examples/orders-api-bad.openapi.json --format markdown`
- Enforce shared team ruleset: `python3 api_validator.py --spec "services/*/openapi.json" --config .api-rules.example.json`
- GitHub Action: `uses: api-design-tools/api-design-principles@v1`
